relationships.subject: ripasudil
relationships.evidence_quote: Three days after SCI, the intensity of phosphorylated p38 and Iba1 immunoreactive cells in the dorsal horn was significantly lower in the ripasudil treated groups than in the saline group.

relationships.subject: ripasudil
relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, the withdrawal threshold of the ripasudil-treated rats was significantly higher than that of the saline-injected rats on 14 days and 28 days after SCI.

relationships.subject: ROCK
relationships.evidence_quote: We also reported that the RhoA/Rho-associated coiled-coil containing protein kinase (ROCK) pathway mediates p38 activation in spinal microglia in peripheral nerve injury.

key_findings: SCI increases p-p38 and Iba1 in lumbar dorsal horn microglia at 3 and 7 days.
ROCK inhibitor ripasudil reduces p-p38 and raises withdrawal threshold after SCI without changing microglia number.
